create_DatasetInfo: create a DatasetInfo dataclass instance with name, in_tfds, path, and data_format fields
build_DatasetInfo_cls_name: build the cls_name attribute from a snake_case dataset name using naming.snake_to_camelcase
build_DatasetInfo_tfds_api: build the tfds_api import path based on whether the dataset is in_tfds or external
build_DatasetInfo_ds_import: build the ds_import module path from a filesystem path for in-tfds datasets
